name: The League of Moveable Type
summary: The first open-source font foundry: 18 fonts free under the Open Font License, plus type education.
description: An open-source font foundry running since 2009, offering 18 fonts (League Gothic, League Spartan, League Mono, Raleway, Orbitron, Ostrich Sans …) free to download with source under the Open Font License. Font pages detail language support, character sets and OpenType features; the site also publishes a font licensing guide, a newsletter and a $299/year membership with typography courses (not open yet).
contains: 18 fonts incl. League Gothic, League Spartan, League Mono, Raleway, Orbitron, Ostrich Sans
all fonts free under the Open Font License
font pages with language support, glyph counts and OpenType features
